description_en: Queries a list of context stores
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop list-context-stores --agent-space my-agent-space --context-store-name my-context-store --context-type experience --max-results 20 --next-token MTIzNDU2Nzg5MA== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListContextStores

parameters.description_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.description_en: Filters context stores by name. Exact match is supported. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied.
parameters.description_zh: 按上下文库名称过滤，支持精确匹配；不传表示不过滤
parameters.help_en: Filters context stores by name. Exact match is supported. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按上下文库名称过滤，支持精确匹配；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.description_en: Filters context stores by type, such as experience or memory. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied.
parameters.description_zh: 按上下文库类型过滤，例如 experience / memory；不传表示不过滤
parameters.help_en: Filters context stores by type, such as experience or memory. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按上下文库类型过滤，例如 experience / memory；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of context stores to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.
parameters.description_zh: 本次最多返回的上下文库条数，默认 20，最大 100
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of context stores to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 本次最多返回的上下文库条数，默认 20，最大 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request.
parameters.description_zh: 分页 Token，传入上一次响应中的 nextToken 翻页；首次请求不传
parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
